lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximate vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a repeating grid of local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, functioning as anchor nodes within a faint rectilinear luminance pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and a shadow-gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Concentrated distribution of high-luminance micro-blobs on the dorsal-anterior cephalic region and across the entire visible surface of the pectoral fin.
